1. Timing of Surgical Prophylaxis :'Golden Hour' (60 mins prior to incision time)
2. Incision and Closure time of the surgeries in surgeon's operative records is mandatory

3. For Surgeries extending 3 hrs of incision or 4 hrs of antibiotic administration or if blood loss is more than 1.5 L an additional dose of Inj. Cefazolin/Cefuroxime is administered. 5. Repeat dose is not required in renal insufficiency.
6. For MRSA colonizers add single dose of Vancomycin in addition to the Prophylaxis
